title: Cycle staffing heatmap and tranche-based scope-decision playbook
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Teams repeatedly encounter mid-cycle staff slippage and unclear rules for scope cuts, which causes rushed quality trade-offs and missed OKR milestones. Goal: Produce a concise, operational playbook that product managers and engineering leads use at the start of each cycle to (1) convert staffing availability into a heatmap, (2) define tranche buckets (A/B/C) for scope with clear cut rules, and (3) prescribe surge/soft-freeze triggers and role-rotation guidance. Deliverables: heatmap template (sheet), tranche classification rubric, decision-tree for mid-cycle triage, and a one-page exec summary for stakeholders.

Action items: Marcus to draft heatmap template; Priya (Design) to propose communication templates for ‘soft freeze’ announcements. Agreed on tranche names A/B/C where A = must-deliver, B = target, C = deferable.

Seeking feedback from infra and platform managers on buffer sizing.
